records.inherited_baseline: 清代旧例仍保留满汉不通婚的正式身份边界，民间虽已有规避和事实通婚。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 清廷可以正式解除这一族群婚姻边界，使满汉官民合法自由通婚。
records.background_trend: 二百余年社会交往和事实通婚是背景；1902年正式开除禁令及其后公开联姻是本人实际控制窗口新增。
records.attributable_change: 1902年懿旨明确准满汉官民彼此结婚、开除旧禁；原需规避的婚姻关系获得合法身份。
records.field_coverage: 满、汉两大身份群体的婚姻合法性；实际新增通婚量未闭合。
records.durability_and_handoff: 禁令解除后未恢复，法律开放稳定交班。

counterevidence.summary: 民间此前已有事实通婚；且本正向与庚子教民迫害无关，不能解除A轴硬负向。

records.inherited_baseline: 1899年前清廷虽长期存在民教冲突，中央正式政策仍要求保护教堂和教民，中国基督徒并未处于中央政府支持的群体性暴力状态。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 即使与列强冲突加剧，清廷仍可维持对中国教民的法律保护，并把对外战争与国内宗教身份群体切开。
records.background_trend: 山东、直隶反教情绪及地方冲突先于中央转向；只消费慈禧实际控制下朝廷由压制拳民转向利用、任用亲拳路线、宣战及随之形成的国家—拳民合流环境。
records.attributable_change: 1900年春夏朝廷对义和团政策反复后，在慈禧实际控制下明显转向利用拳民对外，任命端王主持总理衙门并于6月21日宣战；北方中国教民成为大规模身份性攻击对象，大量教堂、社区被毁，数以千计中国教民死亡。并非所有地方暴行均由慈禧逐案命令，但中央政策转向显著扩大了群体安全崩解。
records.field_coverage: 华北多省中国基督徒及其家庭、聚落和教会共同体。
records.durability_and_handoff: 暴力高峰持续数月并在战败后迅速逆转，但死亡、社区毁灭和流离不可逆。
records.cross_scene_replication: Beijing/Zhili/Shanxi and other North-China Christian community violence

counterevidence.summary: 中央早期曾下令保护教民，部分地方督抚拒绝执行亲拳路线，且大量杀戮由拳民和地方官军直接实施；因此不定R4，也不把全部义和团暴行归慈禧本人。

records.inherited_baseline: 1898年前旧科举—书院仍为主通道，已有洋务学堂和百日维新新学扩张尝试。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 晚清国家已具备建立分级新学体系的行政与财政工具，但全国层级转换、科举退出和新身份入口仍需持续国家决策。
records.background_trend: 洋务及地方新学先存；1898政变后绝大多数维新措施被撤回，京师大学堂虽保留但规模与方针收缩。1901后本人实际控制下又主动启动新政，直接修复并超过该回撤。
records.attributable_change: 1898政变后教育改革曾明显回撤；1901后新政转向全国新式学堂扩张，1904学制建立分级学校框架，1905停科举将主人才通道转向新学，并打开女子、专业和留学等新入口。最终状态不只是恢复1898方案，而是跨场景完成全国教育体系范式转换。
records.field_coverage: 全国分级学校、专业教育、人才认证、女子教育及科举退出。
records.durability_and_handoff: 新学体系与教育行政框架跨清亡继续成为后继教育主结构。
records.cross_scene_replication: school-system rules; provincial implementation; professional education; female education; examination-route replacement

counterevidence.summary: 1898回撤真实存在，但1901后由同一实际控制者直接反向修复并超过该回撤。因此1898只作为同一教育链内部反证压低带位，不再作为独立N2进入P/N；地区质量、财政和执行差异继续阻止CIV4-HIGH。

records.inherited_baseline: 洋务时期已有同文馆、译书机构和民间翻译出版，1901年新政接手的并非西学翻译空白。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 成熟印刷和新式教育条件下可建立国家级译书、编书、教科书审定与出版机制。
records.background_trend: 1900年代民间和地方翻译热潮属于背景；只消费中央组织、审定、编译和已出版产品。
records.attributable_change: 1902后京师大学堂译书、编书机构及1905后学部教材审定、编译出版形成国家知识转译—教材生产链。
records.field_coverage: 外文教科书、西学多学科译介、全国学校教材审定与官方编纂出版。
records.durability_and_handoff: 国家教材审定和编译出版机制进入后继教育出版体系。
records.cross_scene_replication: translation bureau; compilation office; textbook review; official textbook publication

counterevidence.summary: 民间和地方翻译贡献巨大，不回填给慈禧；仅R2。

records.inherited_baseline: 1898年夏改革派士人、报刊、学会和新学讨论网络快速扩张，改革者仍具有较高政治与表达安全。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 政争和改革纠偏不要求以处死、监禁和全面打断改革知识网络来解决。
records.background_trend: 改革方案本身争议极大；只消费政变后处死/监禁改革者及改革知识网络骤然中断，不把所有废政重复算C。
records.attributable_change: 1898年9月慈禧及保守派重新夺回政治控制，光绪被长期幽禁，谭嗣同等改革者被处死，康梁等逃亡，多项改革讨论与报刊/学会网络迅速中断，形成明确的精英知识与表达安全收缩。
records.field_coverage: 改革派官员、士人、报刊和学会等新学政治—知识网络。
records.durability_and_handoff: 人员死亡不可逆，但1901后新政重新吸收大量改革议题，限制长期结构损害，故不升R3。

counterevidence.summary: 改革网络在海外及民间继续，1901后朝廷又重启多项改革方向，因此止R2。

records.inherited_baseline: 努尔哈赤末年汉民依附与群体敌意严重，蒙古/汉人参与通道不稳定。
records.attributable_change: 分出部分汉民另编民户、扩大汉官参与，建立蒙古与汉军旗分，使多群体获得较稳定身份与政治军事参与。
records.field_coverage: 辽东汉民、汉军、蒙古降附群体。
records.durability_and_handoff: 二十四旗结构稳定交班。
records.cross_scene_replication: civil-status repair; Mongol banners; Han banners

counterevidence.summary: 群体层级和新俘虏仍存在，故压LOW。

records.inherited_baseline: 努尔哈赤末年生员遭严重打击，后金缺乏稳定学校—考试—任职链。
records.attributable_change: 建立文馆教育和多轮满汉蒙古生员考试，并将原为包衣/奴仆的儒生拔出，形成重复选试与任职出口。
records.field_coverage: 辽东识字精英、多族生员、原奴籍儒生。
records.durability_and_handoff: 成为入关后文官与科举体系的重要基线。
records.cross_scene_replication: school; exams; status release; office placement

counterevidence.summary: 规模仍限辽东精英，未到入关后的全国常规科举。

records.inherited_baseline: 辽东汉民原具普通自由民身份，战争前不存在后金同等范围世袭包衣/阿哈依附。
records.attributable_change: 征服后大量汉民遭杀戮、身份降格、庄园依附和世袭阿哈化，部分早降或技能人口另有编旗任用。
records.field_coverage: 辽东汉民跨生命安全、自由身、户籍和庄园依附场景。
records.durability_and_handoff: 依附身份进入皇太极继承基线。
records.cross_scene_replication: killing; dependency; household redistribution; selective incorporation

counterevidence.summary: 有限编旗和任用形成R2正向，但不解除系统性硬负向。

records.inherited_baseline: parts of the southwest remained under hereditary native chieftain jurisdiction with differentiated resident status
records.attributable_change: 西南部分世袭土司辖民转为国家直接编辖，形成较一致的臣民和司法行政入口；学校、交通和跨地域官员进入带来有限共同体连接
records.field_coverage: selected southwest jurisdictions and residents, with limited school-transport-official connection

records.inherited_baseline: Qing provincial education already had prefectural-county schools and some academies, but lacked the same centrally funded provincial-capital academy layer across the empire
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: mature Qing administration and printing made expansion feasible, so credit depends on realized institutional nodes rather than raw school counts
records.background_trend: private academies and local schools pre-existed; only the 1733 centrally backed provincial-capital academy expansion and its operating funding are consumed
records.attributable_change: 雍正十一年命各省省会设书院并由中央赐帑支持，形成跨省稳定的省级高等教育节点；书院与学政、科举人才培养相连，实际扩展地方士子的学习与进身准备通道
records.field_coverage: provincial-capital academies across the empire, with learners still concentrated among male examination-oriented literati
records.durability_and_handoff: the centrally recognized provincial academy layer persisted and expanded under successors

counterevidence.summary: academies were not mass schools and remained closely tied to examination-oriented male literati; absolute Qing school abundance is not backfilled to Yongzheng

records.inherited_baseline: 康熙朝初稿已成但未付梓，编排校定和实际印本尚未完成
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 清代成熟刻书环境能支持大型官书，但万卷铜活字排印仍属异常高成本
records.background_trend: 前期稿本和康熙批准是继承基线；雍正窗口只消费重校定稿、铜活字印成和可存续成品
records.attributable_change: 命蒋廷锡重校《古今图书集成》，完成万卷分类百科并以铜活字印成六十四部；知识汇聚和印刷技术成果显著，但当期副本和读者范围很窄
records.field_coverage: a ten-thousand-volume multidisciplinary corpus and sixty-four printed sets, broad in subject but narrow in copies and readers
records.durability_and_handoff: the printed sets and classification system survived, while most contemporaries had no direct access

counterevidence.summary: only sixty-four sets were printed, so size and technical novelty do not imply broad public access

records.era_relative_difficulty: 清代成熟刻书环境能支持大型官书，但万卷铜活字排印仍属异常高成本

records.inherited_baseline: scholarly and private textual expression retained more room before the repeated high-level cases
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: mature commercial and scholarly publication networks made both circulation and state suppression more consequential
records.background_trend: political tension was inherited, but the ruler-window prosecutions and posthumous textual punishment were attributable choices
records.attributable_change: 汪景祺、查嗣庭、吕留良等文字案件把私人著述、日记和既往思想转化为严厉刑罚与禁毁对象，形成跨案件的学术表达安全收缩
records.field_coverage: multiple named scholar, family, manuscript, and publication networks affected by prosecution and suppression
records.durability_and_handoff: case precedents and chilling effects extended beyond a single punished author
records.cross_scene_replication: independent literary-inquisition cases involving different texts and scholarly networks

counterevidence.summary: the exact scale of downstream self-censorship is not converted into a raw headcount

records.era_relative_difficulty: mature commercial and scholarly publication networks made both circulation and state suppression more consequential

records.inherited_baseline: frontier groups faced invasion, unstable allegiance, and incomplete participation channels at the start of the relevant windows
records.attributable_change: 喀尔喀遭侵后获内徙、运米赈抚并进入旗盟爵秩体系；蒙古诸部长期存在朝觐、赈济和制度化政治参与；西藏军事收束后形成册封与持续治理安排
records.field_coverage: Khalkha and other Mongol groups plus Tibet across relief, settlement, audience, titles, participation, and governance
records.durability_and_handoff: participation and governance arrangements persisted beyond immediate crises, with hierarchy and coercion limiting equality
records.cross_scene_replication: multiple independent Mongol relief-participation scenes and a Tibetan settlement-governance scene

records.inherited_baseline: the inherited banner schools lacked the same realized astronomy-mathematics and Russian-language specialist tracks with explicit service destinations
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: a centralized early-Qing state could train small specialist cohorts, but broad banner education remained institutionally and fiscally difficult
records.background_trend: the basic banner-school system was inherited from Shunzhi; only Kangxi-window new tracks and realized entry routes are consumed
records.attributable_change: 康熙九年从八旗官学生中分旗选员入钦天监学习天文算法并设置考试补官路径；四十七年亲自过问开设俄罗斯文馆，选蒙古旗学生培养俄语翻译
records.field_coverage: several small, centrally selected specialist cohorts across Manchu, Mongol, and Hanjun banner learners; not general banner or commoner access

counterevidence.summary: Kangxi-period banner schools remained small and restricted; broader localization and access expansion belongs mainly to Yongzheng

records.inherited_baseline: no comparable integrated set of dictionary, mathematical-calendrical, surveying, and mapping outputs was complete, while scholarly textual expression retained greater safety before the major literary case
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: large court compilations and surveys were feasible, but completing widely used reference works and cross-province scientific measurement remained exceptional; mature print also made censorship more consequential
records.background_trend: late-imperial printing and scholarship lowered circulation costs; the commissioned knowledge products and the ruler-window literary prosecution remain attributable
records.attributable_change: 敕修《康熙字典》、校刊《全唐诗》并形成律历、测绘等多领域国家知识产品；同时南山集案把私人史学著述转化为重刑和禁毁对象，造成学术表达安全明显收缩
records.field_coverage: lexicography, poetry corpus, calendrical mathematics, surveying and cartography on the positive side; private historical writing and scholar-family networks on the negative side
records.durability_and_handoff: reference works and scientific products remained durable, while the literary-inquisition precedent and chilling effect extended beyond the individual case
records.cross_scene_replication: independent textual-reference, mathematical-calendrical, surveying and cartographic production chains

counterevidence.summary: positive products were concentrated in state and elite networks; the negative case imposes a hard gate

records.inherited_baseline: Nurhaci-period Manchu writing existed but left substantial phonological ambiguity and limited standardization
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: the inherited script could be revised using Mongolian-derived diacritics to improve administrative precision
records.background_trend: the earlier script itself is inherited; only the Hong Taiji-window reform and resulting standard use are consumed
records.attributable_change: 1632年命达海等改进无圈点满文，以圈点区分音值，形成此后稳定使用的有圈点满文标准体系
records.field_coverage: administrative, archival and elite textual production across the Manchu state
records.durability_and_handoff: the revised script became the standard Manchu writing system through the Qing period

counterevidence.summary: this was a major reform of an inherited script, not creation from zero

records.inherited_baseline: multiple Inner Asian groups and orders existed before expansion and resettlement
records.attributable_change: 土尔扈特回归后形成朝觐、暂驻、编旗与物资供给；新疆多群体进入伯克、旗盟、屯牧等差异化制度秩序
records.field_coverage: multi-region integration chains coexist with near-destruction of the Zunghar social order
records.durability_and_handoff: institutional incorporation endured, while population destruction was irreversible
records.cross_scene_replication: multiple settlement and governance scenes plus a separate systemic destruction scene

records.inherited_baseline: large bodies of texts remained dispersed and available before collection and prohibition
records.attributable_change: 征集遗书、设馆纂辑、从永乐大典辑佚并形成四库总目，构成大型保存整理工程；禁书、抽毁、删改与刑罚威慑造成知识损失和表达安全收缩
records.field_coverage: large state preservation-cataloguing and broad targeted destruction-censorship operated together
records.durability_and_handoff: cataloguing and preserved copies endured; destroyed or altered texts and chilling effects were partly irreversible
records.era_relative_difficulty: adjudicated against MATURE_PRINT_MULTILINGUAL_AND_CROSS_REGIONAL, not raw copies or reader counts

records.inherited_baseline: Jurchen political communication relied on Mongolian and Chinese writing without a dedicated Manchu-language writing system
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: a rising Jurchen polity could adapt Mongolian script to its language, but practical state adoption required deliberate design and institutional use
records.background_trend: Mongolian script supplied the model; the creation, state adoption and Manchu-language administrative use are ruler-window increments
records.attributable_change: 1599年命额尔德尼、噶盖以蒙古字母创制无圈点满文，使女真人首次拥有稳定的本语言国家书写工具；此后政令、法律与文书实际使用满文，并成为1632年有圈点满文改革的直接基础
records.field_coverage: state orders, laws, archives and elite textual communication in the rising Manchu polity
records.durability_and_handoff: old Manchu operated for more than three decades and directly handed off into the improved standard script; it did not itself remain unchanged through the Qing

counterevidence.summary: the script retained phonological ambiguity and required Hong Taiji's 1632 reform; this caps the band at CIV3-LOW rather than treating it like the fully matured later script

records.inherited_baseline: late-Qing education remained dominated by classical examination preparation and a limited modern-school layer
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: the late-Qing state could use modern administrative and fiscal tools to create a broad school network, though implementation remained regionally uneven
records.background_trend: missionary and local new schools pre-existed, but the nationwide school system, education administration and examination abolition were attributable New Policies choices under Cixi's actual-control window
records.attributable_change: 1901后新政推动全国新式学堂体系，1904学制形成层级化学校框架，1905停科举并将人才通道转向新学；数年内学校和学生规模大幅扩张，并正式打开女子教育等新入口
records.field_coverage: nationwide primary-secondary-specialist school expansion and new female/professional access, with rural and fiscal unevenness and abrupt closure of the old examination route
records.durability_and_handoff: the new-school system and education-administration framework survived the Qing and became the principal successor education structure
records.cross_scene_replication: school-system rules, provincial implementation, professional education and female education produced independent access scenes

counterevidence.summary: regional quality was uneven and ending the examination route imposed transition costs; these do not erase the realized new-school expansion

records.inherited_baseline: 明末战乱造成政权和社会秩序崩解，但汉地居民仍保有原有发式服制、自由民身份和土地社区结构。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 征服政权可以通过保留地方官、恢复行政和渐进整合建立统治，并非必须以全国性身份强制和大规模依附化实现。
records.background_trend: 入关征服与八旗安置造成结构压力；具体剃发易服、圈地、投充和严厉逃人制度属于摄政政府可归责选择。
records.attributable_change: 一方面保留并吸纳大量明官、汉官进入新政权；另一方面以剃发易服强制身份外观，圈占近畿土地并推动投充、逃人体系，使大量居民失地、依附化或承担连坐风险，形成跨身份、自由身和社区结构的系统性损害。
records.field_coverage: 汉地广泛身份表达、近畿及部分扩展地区土地社区、旗下依附人口与满汉政治参与同时受影响。
records.durability_and_handoff: 剃发制度长期延续；圈地、投充、逃人造成的身份和社区损害在后续数十年继续产生社会冲突。
records.cross_scene_replication: identity/dress coercion; land enclosure and dependent status; Han-official incorporation

counterevidence.summary: 保留明官、建立满汉官僚体系构成真实整合收益，但不能抵消跨场景硬负向。

records.inherited_baseline: 鼎革战争使原明代科举—学校人才通道在大量地区中断。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 可较快恢复既有士人考试入口，但其社会结构主要继承明制，不能因恢复速度快就视为新教育范式。
records.background_trend: 士人求取新朝功名存在自然需求；恢复科举和实际录取属于摄政政权主动重启的人才通道。
records.attributable_change: 入关后迅速恢复乡会试和进士取士，实际使明末失去或未获功名的士人进入清朝官僚体系；属于战后明确恢复而非新的社会开放。
records.field_coverage: 新占汉地士人考试与入仕通道，社会身份和性别边界基本继承明制。
records.durability_and_handoff: 恢复后的科举成为清代长期人才通道。

counterevidence.summary: 主要是恢复明制，不是新增大众教育或新身份入口。

records.inherited_baseline: 亲政时已继承满汉官僚并用，同时圈地、投充、逃人等征服期制度仍造成严重身份和社会摩擦。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 可以通过放宽依附制度、提高汉官共同参与和减少征服性差等来修复社会关系。
records.background_trend: 多尔衮死后存在自然政策纠偏空间；只有福临亲政窗口实际落实部分才归本人。
records.attributable_change: 亲政后提高满汉官员共同奏事和汉官参与，部分抑制投充等弊端；但逃人法等依附身份制度继续强化并造成广泛连坐与社会压迫，修复与延续损害并存。
records.field_coverage: 中央满汉官僚参与与旗下依附人口两个不同社会层面。
records.durability_and_handoff: 满汉共同治理有所推进，但依附制度并未在本人窗口根本解除。

counterevidence.summary: 不能把多尔衮摄政期的满汉通婚、初设汉官全部回填给福临本人；也不能把清初弊政全归多尔衮而忽略顺治亲政后的延续。

records.inherited_baseline: 此前已有若干洋务学堂和新式学校，但无同等中央国立综合大学及最高教育行政节点。
records.attributable_change: 1898年直接批准建立京师大学堂并核准章程；政变后多数新政撤销，但大学堂保留并实际招生开学，成为持续存在的近代中央综合大学。
records.field_coverage: 一个具有制度创新和长期延续性的中央现代大学节点。
records.durability_and_handoff: 京师大学堂政变后仍保留，成为北京大学前身。

counterevidence.summary: 百日维新极短，多数全国教育规划未落实；只消费京师大学堂实际存续结果。

source_refs: 北京大学校史馆京师大学堂资料

records.inherited_baseline: 乾隆后期仍遗留严厉文字狱、禁毁和高压思想表达环境。
records.attributable_change: 嘉庆亲政初期相对乾隆末年的文字狱与言论高压明显收缩，并主动广开言路；学术文化研究亦指出嘉庆前期终结雍乾式文字狱高压，扩大士人著述和政治表达安全。
records.field_coverage: 士人著述、政治言说和学术表达的安全边界有所放宽。
records.durability_and_handoff: 前期政策显著改变乾隆末高压气氛，但后期有所收紧。

counterevidence.summary: 并非正式废除所有因言获罪；洪亮吉案显示进言边界仍严格，嘉庆后期又转向更强理学正统，因此只取CIV2-MID。

source_refs: 清华大学嘉庆朝文化政策研究
